messages:
Alice: Hey team — prepping for the Thursday change window. planning to push api@4.0.0-rc2 -> runtime@2.3.1 -> router@1.9.0 -> console@3.0.0.
Ben: timeline?
Alice: 02:00 UTC quiet window. 30m stagged handoff per service. deploy-bot will run canary then traffic shift.
Carol: +1. I want the console pin kept to 3.0.0 for compatibility with telemetry schema.
Deploy-bot: deploy plan created: canary=5% for 10m, then 50% 15m, then 100% 10m. Rollback on error rate >2.5% or latency p95 increase >200ms.
Dave: Where are the release notes? link: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-25
Eva: Added smoke tests for routing headers and KV eviction. Failing tests should block canary.
Ben: Can we pin the runtime kernel to q8-runtime-2026-03 to avoid perf regression?
Alice: Yes pinning runtime kernel. Also adding console feature-flag off by default.
Carol: Need an explicit fallback model variant for API if dedicated capacity shortfall hits.
Alice: plan: api -> fallback to api-lite@3.9.5 if gpuset < 1% avail. Will update docs.
Deploy-bot: preflight checks: infra-health=ok, canary-image=present, smoke-tests=queued
Ben: On-call: @Dave will watch metrics and trigger rollback if we see sustained errors.
Dave: I'll be on standby 01:30-03:00 UTC. Have rollback playbook open.
Eva: Pushed release notes draft. Please review lines 12-18 for KV eviction caveat.
Carol: Confirmed telemetry schema backward compatible. console pin ok.
Alice: Final ask: everyone ack to proceed with the deploybot plan. :eyes:
Ben: ack
Carol: ack
Dave: ack
Eva: ack
Alice: Deploy scheduled. I'll post the final commit hash and unlock the queue 30m before window.
Deploy-bot: commit set to sha256:abc123...def. queue unlocked at 01:30 UTC.
Alice: closing thread — will ping if any change. :rocket:
